observed: The first three checkpoints were exact. Checkpoint 4 preserved all 205 inherited tests but failed 22 of 225 current tests, concentrated in three-valued MUX and reduction semantics.
The agent changed no file. It passed 526/529 inherited tests and failed every one of the 37 new tests because the opt command was absent; the aggregate test-pass rate was still 92.9%.
The loop ended after 4.395 seconds and four recorded steps without changing a file. Only 3/28 current tests passed, including 0/14 core tests.
A 126-step extension added 608 lines and removed 121, but the final snapshot passed only 9/104 tests and retained just 8/75 inherited tests.
Every checkpoint-2 test passed in isolation, while two inherited status-code defects kept the result at 91/93. Checkpoints 3 and 4 were configured without prior tests.
A rewrite added 226 lines and removed 715. It lifted total correctness from 47/134 to 135/164, passed all four new core tests and 28/30 current tests, but retained only 107/134 inherited tests.
The trajectory passed every checkpoint's core threshold but no isolated or strict threshold. The final loop changed no file and ended at 59/89 tests.
The final snapshot passed 160/167 tests. Four inherited text-extraction defects and three new compact-JSON or mixed-query defects remained.
